paras: Cercosaura steyeri is a species of lizard in the family Gymnophthalmidae. The species is endemic to Argentina.
The specific name, steyeri, is in honor of Brazilian herpetologist Ligia Steyer Krause.
C. steyeri is found in Mercedes Department, Corrientes Province, Argentina.
The preferred habitat of C. steyeri is savanna, at altitudes of 0–100 m (0–328 ft)
